summary: Verified end-to-end the two fixes: (1) task/subtask context-menu now clamps within the viewport when opened near the bottom, with 'KILIT AYARLARI' fully visible; (2) new 'Geri alt göreve dönüştür' (ctx-demote-to-subtask) menu item appears ONLY on promoted child tasks and correctly demotes the child back to a subtask on its parent (child deleted, parent regains the item as subtask with preserved text). Backend endpoint POST /api/tasks/{id}/demote-to-subtask verified (200 for promoted task, 400 for non-promoted). No regressions observed in existing context-menu actions or promoted-child badges/progress counter.
critical_code_review_comments: Toast selector for '.Toaster / [role=status]' not matched during UI test; consider adding data-testid on success toasts for deterministic tests (functionality itself worked).
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral ZTEST_* tasks (parent+subtask, promoted, then demoted) via API through the logged-in browser session and cleaned all of them up at end. Final DELETE sweep from Python found 0 residual test tasks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token is stored in localStorage key 'sertex_token_v1' (not 'token'). Tasks panel is opened by clicking [data-testid=tab-tasks]. Subtasks are only persisted via PATCH /api/tasks/{id} with a subtasks array of {id, text, done}; POST /api/tasks does NOT accept subtasks in creation payload. Promote via POST /api/tasks/{pid}/subtasks/{sid}/promote, demote via POST /api/tasks/{cid}/demote-to-subtask (returns updated parent). Only 'is_status'-restricted values are accepted on PATCH status (avoid 'in_progress'). Viewport height in the test browser is 1080 regardless of set_viewport_size. Context menu top/bottom measurements verified: bottom position never exceeded window.innerHeight in any tested scenario.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification only. Both fixes measured working: menu at bottom clamped to top=572-601 / bottom=1067-1072 (vh=1080). KILIT AYARLARI at bottom=1067 fully visible. Subtask menu bottom=1072. Demote flow removed child (task-item-{cid} no longer in DOM) and restored subtask row inside parent's inner HTML.
